decision_conditions: <p><span id="docs-internal-guid-6d295be9-7fff-7586-36c4-b9db722fd6b3"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">In the absence of a Unilateral Undertaking or a Section 106 Agreement securing appropriate mitigation by restricting future occupiers of the development from obtaining parking permits within the Controlled Parking Zone, the proposed development would likely exacerbate existing parking stress and congestion on the surrounding highway network. The development would, therefore, be contrary to policies LP43 (Transport and Development) and LP45 (Parking and Car-Free Development) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 and policies T4 (Assessing and mitigating transport impacts) and T6 (Car parking) of the London Plan (2021).</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-ad570a5f-7fff-aeea-6df8-fd1cb0236e41"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">In the absence of an Energy Statement, or&nbsp; Unilateral Undertaking or Section 106 Agreement securing a financial contribution towards carbon offsetting, the development fails to demonstrate how the maximum feasible reduction in carbon emissions and overheating mitigation have been achieved on site, contrary to policies LP54 (Overheating and Adapting to Climate Change) and LP55 (Mitigating Climate Change) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033) and policies SI 2 (Minimising greenhouse gas emissions) and SI 4 (Managing heat risk) of the London Plan (2021).</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-fad88c12-7fff-2a4a-e8b1-e09f1689ccbf"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">The proposed development, by reason of the inappropriate location and inadequate provision of cycle parking, fails to demonstrate that cycle parking would be safe, secure and conveniently accessible for all users. The proposal would therefore be contrary to Policy LP42 (Walking and Cycling)&nbsp; of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 and the Hackney Transport Strategy 2015-2025.</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-3ba6069c-7fff-47c7-14ee-aa69ff05fe93"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">Insufficient information has been submitted to alleviate the Council’s concern that suitable refuse and recycling storage for the proposed development has been provided, to the detriment of prospective living conditions, pollution and local environs, thus failing to meet the requirements of policy LP57 (Waste) of the Hackney Local Plan LP33 (2020) and policy D6 (Housing quality and standards) of the London Plan (2021).</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-8f04801d-7fff-d8b2-fbaf-f0900b738179"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">Insufficient information has been submitted to alleviate the Council’s concern that the development would provide a suitable standard of residential accommodation in terms of internal floorspace, standards and head height for future&nbsp; occupiers, to the detriment of their prospective living conditions. As such, the proposal is contrary to policy D6 (Housing quality and standards) of the London Plan (2021), policy LP17 (Housing Design) of the Hackney Local Plan LP33 (2020) and the GLA's Technical Housing Standards- Nationally Described Space Standard (2015). </span></span></p>
description:
Conversion of existing dwelling into 3 self-contained flats comprising:
•	1 x 3-bedroom flat over ground floor and basement,
•	1 x studio flat on the first floor,
•	1 x duplex studio flat across the first and second floors,
by way of:
•	the creation of a new basement with front and rear light wells,
•	a rear extension at ground floor level,
•	the conversion of the loft space with 3 x rear dormers,
with associated private amenity space, secure bicycle storage and refuse storage.
